articles.title: Mobile Snatching Caught on CCTV in Ghaziabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking mobile snatching incident was reported from Pratap Vihar in Ghaziabad, where bike-borne miscreants targeted a young man walking on the street and fled after snatching his mobile phone. The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

body.html:
A shocking mobile snatching incident was reported from Pratap Vihar in Ghaziabad, where bike-borne miscreants targeted a young man walking on the street and fled after snatching his mobile phone.

The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera. The footage shows the criminals approaching the youth on a motorcycle and escaping within seconds after committing the crime. Police are examining the CCTV visuals to identify the accused.

articles.title: Bajrang Dal Leader Externed from Bareilly for 6 Months
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bareilly police have invoked the Goonda Act against Bajrang Dal leader Rishabh Thakur and externed him from the district for six months. Authorities have warned that if he is found anywhere in Bareilly during this period, a fresh criminal case will be registered against him.

body.html:
Bareilly police have invoked the Goonda Act against Bajrang Dal leader Rishabh Thakur and externed him from the district for six months. Authorities have warned that if he is found anywhere in Bareilly during this period, a fresh criminal case will be registered against him.

Rishabh Thakur was earlier jailed for allegedly assaulting boys and girls who were celebrating a birthday party at a café, accusing them of “love jihad”. Soon after his release from jail, police took preventive action and banished him from the district to maintain law and order.

articles.title: Anganwadi Cook Dies Saving Children from Bee Attack in MP’s Neemuch
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Neemuch (Madhya Pradesh): In a tragic incident in Ranpur village of Neemuch district, an Anganwadi cook lost her life after saving around 20 children from a bee attack at the Madawada Panchayat Anganwadi centre. The deceased has been identified as Kanchan Bai Meghwal.

body.html:
Neemuch (Madhya Pradesh): In a tragic incident in Ranpur village of Neemuch district, an Anganwadi cook lost her life after saving around 20 children from a bee attack at the Madawada Panchayat Anganwadi centre.

The deceased has been identified as Kanchan Bai Meghwal. According to locals, the children were playing on the Anganwadi premises when a swarm of bees suddenly attacked. Kanchan Bai immediately rushed to their rescue, using tarpaulins and mats to cover the children and shielding them with her own body as she moved them inside the centre.

While the children escaped unharmed, hundreds of bees stung Kanchan Bai, including on her face and mouth. She collapsed at the spot. Constable Kalunath and pilot Rajesh Rathod rushed her to a community health centre, where doctors declared her dead on arrival due to multiple bee stings.

Kanchan Bai was the sole breadwinner of her family and also served as president of the Jai Mata Di Self-Help Group. Her husband Shivalal is paralysed following a stroke. She is survived by one son and two daughters.

After postmortem, her body was brought back to Ranpur village on Tuesday, where villagers paid tribute in silence.

Residents remain fearful as a large beehive still hangs near the Anganwadi centre, close to the village’s only hand pump. Villagers have demanded immediate removal of the beehive and financial assistance for Kanchan Bai’s family.

#Neemuch #MadhyaPradesh #Anganwadi #HeroicSacrifice #BeeAttack #WomenHeroes #RuralIndia #ChildSafety

articles.title: Fire Erupts Inside Lift in Mumbai Building After Balloons Explode; Two Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mumbai: What appeared to be a routine elevator ride turned dangerous after balloons carried by a man exploded inside a lift, triggering a brief fire in a residential building in Goregaon, a western suburb of Mumbai.

body.html:
Mumbai: What appeared to be a routine elevator ride turned dangerous after balloons carried by a man exploded inside a lift, triggering a brief fire in a residential building in Goregaon, a western suburb of Mumbai.

According to CCTV footage, a woman carrying trolley luggage entered the elevator first and pressed her floor button. Moments later, a man carrying a large sack filled with balloons stepped in, followed by another man. Seconds after the lift doors closed, the balloons suddenly exploded, engulfing the elevator in flames.

The fire briefly obscured the camera view. The three occupants were then seen rushing out of the lift, with the balloon seller stumbling after losing balance.

Police said the man and the woman sustained burn injuries and were shifted for medical treatment. A case has been registered against the balloon seller. Authorities are investigating the type of gas used to fill the balloons.

While helium balloons are non-flammable, officials noted that hydrogen-filled balloons are highly inflammable, raising serious safety concerns.

#Mumbai #Goregaon #LiftFire #BalloonExplosion #CCTVFootage #FireIncident #PublicSafety

articles.title: Noida: Drunk Youth Urinates Outside Restaurant Nightly in Posh Sector 18, Probe On
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Noida (Uttar Pradesh): An objectionable incident has come to light from Noida’s posh Sector 18, where a drunken youth allegedly arrived in a luxury Fortuner car every night and urinated outside a woman entrepreneur’s restaurant.

body.html:
Noida (Uttar Pradesh): An objectionable incident has come to light from Noida’s posh Sector 18, where a drunken youth allegedly arrived in a luxury Fortuner car every night and urinated outside a woman entrepreneur’s restaurant.

According to the complaint, the man would reach the spot between 2 and 2:30 am, after the restaurant “Food for You” closed, and repeatedly urinate outside the premises. The woman alleged that when objections were raised, the accused hurled abuses and created a nuisance.

The act was captured on CCTV cameras, following which the restaurant owner lodged a complaint at Sector 20 police station. Police have identified the vehicle through footage and said an investigation is underway.

#Noida #Sector18 #Fortuner #WomenSafety #UPNews #CCTVViral #PublicNuisance #NoidaPolice #CrimeNews

articles.title: Bilaspur: Woman Arrested for Allegedly Stabbing Boyfriend to Death Over Mobile Phone Dispute
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bilaspur (Chhattisgarh): A 22-year-old woman was arrested for allegedly stabbing her boyfriend to death during a heated argument over being blocked on his mobile phone, police said on Tuesday.

body.html:
Bilaspur (Chhattisgarh): A 22-year-old woman was arrested for allegedly stabbing her boyfriend to death during a heated argument over being blocked on his mobile phone, police said on Tuesday.

The deceased has been identified as Kamta Prasad Suryavanshi (25), who was living in a rented house and working at a local hotel. According to police, Kamta met Roshni Suryavanshi (22) on Instagram about six months ago, after which the two entered into a relationship.

Investigators said tensions escalated over the past two to three days after Kamta allegedly stopped communicating with Roshni and blocked her number and messages. Suspecting that he was seeing another woman, Roshni reportedly went to his rented house carrying a knife.

Police said that when Kamta opened the door, Roshni demanded his mobile phone. After he refused, a heated argument broke out, during which she allegedly stabbed him in the chest.

Kamta’s roommate, alerted by the noise, rushed to the room and found him lying on the floor in a pool of blood. He was rushed to a hospital but succumbed to his injuries on the way.

Confirming the arrest, police officer Summat Sahu said a case of murder has been registered. “The woman came to the victim’s room with a knife and demanded his phone. During the altercation, she stabbed him in the chest, leading to his death,” he said.

Police sources said Kamta was the nephew of BJP leader and district panchayat president Rajesh Suryavanshi. The accused has claimed that she carried the knife only to threaten him, but police are investigating her intent, the nature of their relationship and the exact sequence of events.

The body has been sent for post-mortem examination, and further investigation is underway.

#Bilaspur #Chhattisgarh #CrimeNews #InstagramCrime #BJP #Justice #MobileCrime #BreakingNews

articles.title: Uttara Kannada: Man Killed, Two Injured in Clash Over Alleged Illicit Relationship with ‘Guruji’
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Siddapura (Uttara Kannada): A dispute allegedly triggered by a woman’s illicit relationship with a self-styled guru turned violent in Avarguppa village of Siddapura taluk, leaving one man dead and two others seriously injured, police said.

body.html:
Siddapura (Uttara Kannada): A dispute allegedly triggered by a woman’s illicit relationship with a self-styled guru turned violent in Avarguppa village of Siddapura taluk, leaving one man dead and two others seriously injured, police said.

According to the police, Suchitra was allegedly involved in an illicit relationship with Kamalakar Bhat, a native of Shivamogga, who is also referred to as a guruji and originally hails from Hemmanabail village in Siddapura. The matter came to light after Suchitra’s daughter informed her father, Mahesh Nayak, about the relationship.

Mahesh Nayak reportedly went to the police station to lodge a complaint. Following this, a violent attack allegedly took place involving Suchitra’s father Loknath Chaudappa Naik and others. During the assault, Mahesh Nayak, Vasant Nayak and Kumar sustained serious injuries.

Vasant Nayak died on the way to the hospital, while the other two injured are undergoing treatment at a local hospital.

Police said seven people have been arrested in connection with the case, including Kamalakar Bhat, who was absconding after the incident. Of the arrested accused, three were caught in Shivamogga and four in Siddapura.

According to police records, Suchitra has been named as A1, Loknath Chaudappa Naik as A2, an unidentified person as A3, and Kamalakar Bhat as A4. A case has been registered at the Siddapura police station, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Kasaragod Shocker: Father Hacks Daughter to Death, Injured Relative Also Succumbs
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kasaragod (Kerala): An 18-year-old girl, Jumaila, was hacked to death by her father during a violent dispute in Kunchathur, Manjeswaram, while a relative who was injured in the same attack has also died.

body.html:
Kasaragod (Kerala): An 18-year-old girl, Jumaila, was hacked to death by her father during a violent dispute in Kunchathur, Manjeswaram, while a relative who was injured in the same attack has also died.

Jumaila, a native of Thuminad, Kunchathur, succumbed to her injuries while undergoing treatment. Her relative, Sheikh Abba of Manjeswaram, who was critically injured during the incident, died later at a private hospital in Mangaluru.

The incident occurred around 6 pm on Monday. Police said the accused, Umar Farooq, attacked family members during an argument linked to a property dispute amid ongoing divorce negotiations. He had allegedly demanded that the property be registered in his name.

According to relatives, Umar Farooq is a drug addict and had returned to the village about three months ago. Jumaila and her mother had reportedly been staying at a relative’s house due to repeated disputes over his substance abuse.

During the altercation, Umar allegedly attacked Sheikh Abba. Jumaila was injured while trying to stop the assault and later died from severe injuries.

The Manjeswaram police have taken Umar Farooq into custody. Police said they suspect he was under the influence of drugs at the time of the attack. An investigation is ongoing.

articles.title: Women Take the Law Into Their Hands! Liquor Shop Ransacked in Lalitpur Village
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lalitpur (Uttar Pradesh): Around 150 women from Khitwans village in Lalitpur district went on the rampage against a local desi and foreign liquor shop, smashing bottles worth lakhs of rupees and throwing them onto the road in protest.

body.html:
Lalitpur (Uttar Pradesh): Around 150 women from Khitwans village in Lalitpur district went on the rampage against a local desi and foreign liquor shop, smashing bottles worth lakhs of rupees and throwing them onto the road in protest.

The incident took place on February 2–3, near the Mahrauni–Lalitpur road, where angry women, armed with sticks and spades, broke open the liquor shop, dragged out crates and destroyed them, leading to traffic disruption in the area.

The women alleged that the liquor shop’s location within the village had led to rising alcoholism, domestic violence and crime, and said repeated complaints and memorandums submitted to the district administration had been ignored, forcing them to escalate their protest.

Police reached the spot and managed to pacify the crowd. A case has been registered based on the shop owner’s complaint, though no immediate arrests were reported.

Officials said the situation is under control. Similar anti-liquor protests have been reported earlier from nearby villages, including Geron in Jakhlaun, where women had blocked roads demanding closure of liquor shops.

body.html:
Guwahati (Assam): A 13-year-old girl was rescued from horrific abuse after being found locked inside a storage box beneath a bed during a raid by the District Labour Task Force in Guwahati’s Panjabari area on Sunday.

The raid was conducted in the presence of a magistrate at House No. 69, Juripar, owned by Amrin Akhtar Laskar, following complaints from local residents. Officials said the minor had been held as a domestic worker for nearly six years and was allegedly subjected to regular physical abuse.

Sensing the raid, the accused allegedly hid the girl inside the bed’s storage compartment, placed a mattress over it and asked a family member to lie on top. After an intensive search lasting about 25 minutes, officials located and rescued the child.

The girl was immediately provided assistance, and legal action has been initiated against the accused under relevant laws. Further investigation is underway.
